lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalMi: Incremental queries must include an outer ORDER BY clause.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalOr: Incremental queries must sort ascending (ASC); descending (DESC) sorting is not allowed in the outer ORDER BY clause.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalMi: Incremental queries must include the key cursor column [__lastKey].
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalKe: The expression compared with the lastKey variable in WHERE must be identical to the [__lastKey] expression in SELECT; otherwise rows are skipped or resent.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalGr: Cursor group is missing a column or variable. Each group requires column [__lastKey_<group>] and variable lastKey_<group>.
The outer ORDER BY sorts by a column that differs from a group's cursor formula, so rows come out of cursor order. Sort by a column with the [__lastKey_<group>] formula in every branch.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalKe: The cursor column holds only a date/time, so rows sharing the same time are skipped. Append a row key: CONVERT(varchar(8), <time column>, 112) + REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(12), <time column>, 114), ':', '') + '_' + ID.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalUp: The cursor column uses a bare UpdateTime, so newly inserted rows (no UpdateTime yet) are never sent. Use COALESCE(UpdateTime, CreateTime) in both the cursor column and WHERE.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalKe: Compare the cursor with the cursor variable using >; with >= the last row is resent on every run.
The cursor column formats its date/time in an unsortable way, so rows can be skipped. Use CONVERT(varchar(8), <time column>, 112) + REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(12), <time column>, 114), ':', '').
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalCu: The query has a cursor column but uses no cursor variable (source: From the running cursor), so every run resends the same data. Compare the cursor column with the lastKey variable in WHERE, or remove the cursor column to send everything.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalKe: The cursor column must follow CONVERT(varchar(8), <time>, 112) + REPLACE(CONVERT(varchar(12), <time>, 114), ':', '') + '_' + <tail>; the time part must include CreateTime and the tail must never be NULL (wrap nullable columns in ISNULL(<column>, '')); otherwise rows can be skipped.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalOf: An incremental query must not use OFFSET: skipped rows are never sent. Limit rows with TOP.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalUn: A query merging several sources must not share one cursor: a late source loses rows. Give each source its own __lastKey_group column and lastKey_group variable.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalIn: A subquery with TOP must sort ascending by the cursor column: sorting by another column skips rows with a smaller cursor. Change the subquery ORDER BY to the cursor column.
lz.validation.sharedata.sqlIncrementalGr: The running partner query does not contain the corresponding cursor group.
